name: RISE RSO Cream - 1oz.
description: NEW! RISE RSO Cannabis Cream, a revolutionary plant-based topical meticulously formulated with our award winning RSO. This water-based solution features a quick-drying, fast-absorbing formula that penetrates the skin deeply, leaving no residue behind. Enjoy the convenience of its tube application, coupled with an unscented profile, free from parabens and sulfates. Its pH-balanced makeup ensures skin compatibility, and the clear, informative label allows users to be fully informed about their application. Experience natural wellness without compromise. Custom Ratios. Custom Doses. Custom Cannabis. 1oz Cream contains an average of 1,000mg THC | 11mg CBC | 18mg CBG | 25mg CBN Also available in 2:1:1 Advanced Strength Cream and 1:1:1 Recovery Cream.
